Explanation: Name of the subject (from monkey.txt)
Version of the task script
Date of the session (YYYY-MM-DD)
Time the choice was made (HH:MM:SS)
Trial number across the whole test (1 - 5000). Keeps counting across testing days
Trial number for today (keeps counting if the task is restarted the same day)
Testing block number (1 - 500). 1 block = 10 trials with exactly 1 shape probe
Trial number within the current testing block (1 - 10)
"color trial" = standard color trial (same as training v2, with feedback). "shape trial" = shape probe trial (no sound, no colored background, pellet no matter the choice)
Shape probe number (1 - 500). NA on color trials
Shape stimulus pair shown (e.g. 247 = A247.png and B247.png from the stimuli folder, A always shown twice in ABA). Taken from row probe_trial_number of probe_trial_order.txt. NA on color trials
The CORRECT sequence for this monkey (ABA / AAB / BAA)

Position configuration number (1 - 24). Sets which corner the correct sequence and the 2 foils are in. Color and shape trials each have their own pseudorandomized list so the correct sequence is never in the same corner more than 3 trials in a row (within each trial type)
Corner the ABA sequence was in
Corner the AAB sequence was in
Corner the BAA sequence was in
Corner the correct (rule) sequence was in
Sequence the monkey selected (ABA / AAB / BAA)
Sequence the monkey selected as a number: 1 = ABA, 2 = AAB, 3 = BAA
Corner the monkey selected
1 = selected the rule sequence; 0 = selected a foil. On shape trials this is scored the same way, even though the monkey is rewarded no matter what
Response time in seconds from when the 3 sequences appeared to the selection
X position of the cursor (pixels) when the selection was made
Y position of the cursor (pixels) when the selection was made
Red value (0 - 254) of the A color this trial. NA on shape trials
Green value (0 - 254) of the A color this trial. NA on shape trials
Blue value (0 - 254) of the A color this trial. NA on shape trials
Red value (0 - 254) of the B color this trial. NA on shape trials
Green value (0 - 254) of the B color this trial. NA on shape trials
Blue value (0 - 254) of the B color this trial. NA on shape trials
How different A and B looked (CIELAB Delta E), taking the SMALLEST of normal vision / protan colorblind / deutan colorblind. NA on shape trials
Number of pellets dispensed this trial (always pellets_per_correct on shape trials)
